name: Xtream Jelly
overview: TV-optimized Xtream IPTV plugin with pagination and caching.
description: Stream Live IPTV, Video On-Demand, and Series from an Xtream-compatible server. Optimized for slower connections and TV usage with pagination, caching, and large UI targets.

versions.changelog: Initial release with TV-optimized UI, server-side pagination, and response caching.
